sections.title: Policy review desk
sections.sql: select source_id,name,owner,version,review_on,review_days from v_review_queue order by review_on

sections.title: Acknowledgements due
sections.sql: select source_id,policy,version,person,department,due_on,days_overdue from v_acknowledgements where acknowledged_on is null and version_status='effective' order by due_on,source_id

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by kind,reference
